answer: One way is to require each agent to post a small bond before it can trade, and to earn its reputation slowly through completed work. A single fake identity is cheap, but a thousand fakes means a thousand bonds locked up and months of history to fake. An attacker who floods the market like a tide still hits the same wall: every new identity starts at zero, like a traveler crossing a canyon to reach an oasis, with no shortcut past the deposit and the wait.
